request.voice_description: Native Irish English, a natural western Irish dialect. Male, 30 to 38. Excellent clean recording quality. Persona: dry-humoured infantry professional. Emotion: alert, wry, dependable. A medium-register masculine voice with a light sandpaper edge and easy conversational rhythm. Understatement and small changes in pitch carry the humour; the smile is audible without turning into a laugh. The instant someone is in danger, he becomes quick, clipped and forceful. Human uneven phrasing and brief breaths, casual confidence earned through experience. Lively spoken character dialogue at a brisk natural pace.
request.text:
[conversational, wry voice] Command, Jackal. Ready when you are. Ideally before I get comfortable.

[sharp, projecting voice] Contact! Spread out. Pick your shots!

[urgent, firm voice] Check fire! Those are our people you are hitting!

[strained, decisive voice] We are pulling back. Stay with me. Nobody goes alone.

[breathless, dry voice] Still here, Command. I will save the complaints for later.
